BiblicalUsage: Shelah, or Salah, is the patriarch in the line from Shem to Abraham: Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber. Genesis counts his years, one hundred and thirty and three after Eber, and the genealogy moves on through him to Peleg, in whose days the earth was divided.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the long lives in the genealogy are not filler. Shelah lived and begat and died, and the promise moved through him, and I hold that God keeps His line through ordinary men.
